title: Popover
description: Fiori popover with arrow, optional header/footer bars and padded content (ui5-popover).

usage.summary: Show information or actions tied to an opener without leaving the current page.
useWhen: Let users inspect details for a list item or edit related information while staying in context.
Place lightweight content beside the element it describes and keep the background available.
Add a header or footer only when the content needs a title or an action.

avoidWhen.when: Require explicit input or confirmation and block interaction with the surrounding page.
Present contextual content that takes more than one-third of the phone screen.
Offer commands in menu rows or submenus rather than mixed contextual content.
Keep selected-object details in a dedicated area beside the list.
